info.title: Loyalife LBMS API
info.description: REST API for Loyalife's Loyalty Management System. Covers member management, OTP authentication, loyalty transactions, and points redemption.

bearerAuth.description: JWT obtained from Generate Auth Token. Pass as `Authorization: bearer {token}`.

Id.description: Internal member ID — required for UpdateProfileWithAttributes

TierName.description: Current loyalty tier (e.g. Silver, Gold, Platinum)

_xoxo_api_client_idempotency.description: Idempotency key for safe retries. Reuse on retry; new value for genuinely new submissions.

transaction_type.description: DR for purchase/earn, CR for reversal

post.description: Exchange client credentials for a JWT bearer token. Include the returned token in the `Authorization: bearer {token}` header of all subsequent API requests.

client_id.description: Your OAuth client ID from Loyalife Admin → Program Configuration → API

client_secret.description: Your OAuth client secret. Never expose in client-side code.

scope.description: Optional. Binds token to a specific member. JSON-encoded array: `["LOGIN","{RelationReference}"]`. Omit for a general-purpose program token.

tokenExpiresOn.description: ISO 8601 expiry timestamp. Refresh before this time.

post.description: Enroll a new member in your loyalty program.

relation_reference.description: Unique member identifier — typically email-based. Primary key across all APIs.

status.description: Use `5` for Inactive — standard initial state for new enrollments.

dob.description: Date of birth in YYYY-MM-DD format

get.description: Retrieve complete profile details for a member by their RelationReference.

parameters.name: pstrRelationReference
parameters.description: The member's unique reference. URL-encode before passing (e.g. `jane.doe%40example.com`).

post.description: Update an existing member's profile attributes.

id.description: Internal member ID from the `Id` field in Get Member Profile response.

data.description: Profile fields to update. At least one attribute required.

get.description: Look up a member using a unique attribute such as email when RelationReference is unknown.

parameters.name: pstrUniqueAttributeKey
parameters.description: Attribute name to search by (e.g. `email_id`, `mobile_number`). URL-encode before passing.

parameters.name: pstrUniqueAttributeValue
parameters.description: Value to search for. URL-encode before passing.

post.description: Validate a member's password for authentication. Returns the full member profile on success.

Password.description: Member's password hashed using bcrypt or MD5 as configured for your program.

post.description: Send an OTP to a member using their email address.

SourceAddress.description: IP address of the requesting system

post.description: Send an OTP using the member's RelationReference (CID) — preferred when the member identifier is already known.

SourceAddress.description: IP address of the requesting system

post.description: Validate an OTP sent via Generate OTP (email-based flow).

OTP.description: The OTP entered by the member

DestinationAddress.description: IP address of the client device

post.description: Validate a LOGIN OTP using the member's RelationReference.
Submit a synchronous loyalty transaction. Processed immediately by the Rule Engine.

product_code.description: Product or merchant code as configured in your program

transaction_type.description: DR for debit (purchase/earn), CR for credit (reversal)

post.description: Submit one or more transactions asynchronously. Returns a `batch_id` for polling outcomes.

schema.description: Array of transaction objects to process

get.description: Check processing status of a batch submitted via Insert Transaction V2. Poll until `summary.pending === 0`.

post.description: Retrieve a paginated list of a member's loyalty transactions within a date range.

MaximumRange.description: Number of records to return per page

post.description: Retrieve a member's aggregated points balance and loyalty statement totals.
Retrieve the periodic points expiry schedule for a member.

ScheduleDate.description: Date when this batch of points expires

post.description: Verify a member's redeemable points balance before initiating a redemption.
Deduct points from a member's balance. Returns an `ExternalReference` UUID — save it for potential reversals.

Amount.description: Monetary value equivalent of the redemption

200.description: Points redeemed — `ReturnObject` is the ExternalReference UUID

ReturnObject.description: ExternalReference UUID. Store this — required for ReversalPoints if fulfillment fails.

post.description: Reverse a redemption transaction and restore the member's points balance.

RelationReference.description: Must match the RelationReference from the original RedeemPoints call.

MerchantName.description: Must match the MerchantName from the original RedeemPoints call.

ExternalReference.description: UUID returned by RedeemPoints. Identifies the redemption being reversed.
